title: Pigeon Studios resource
description: One resource in the Pigeon Studios version registry. Edit these files by hand; api/ and registry.json are generated by tools/build.mjs, which also enforces rules this schema can't (release order, dates, paid resources needing a store link).

slug.description: Registry ID. Must match the file name and the resource's `pigeon_slug` in fxmanifest.lua. Never change it once released.

name.description: Display name shown in the console.

kind.description: free: public release. paid: sold product.

status.description: active: maintained. deprecated: still works, but owners should move to something else. discontinued: no longer supported.

notice.description: Optional message printed on every check, such as what to move to. Required unless status is active.

repository.description: Public repository, or null if private.

minimum_version.description: Versions older than this are warned to update urgently. Null for none.

version.description: Semantic version without a leading v, such as 1.2.0.

security.description: True if this release fixes a security problem. Owners on any older version are told it's a security update.

url.description: Release page or download link, or null.

notes.description: What changed, written for server owners. The first five are shown in the console.
